welch_t_test.H0: Mean engagement in G1 is equal to mean engagement in G2 (mu_G1 = mu_G2)
welch_t_test.H1: Mean engagement in G1 is not equal to mean engagement in G2 (mu_G1 != mu_G2)

assumptions: Observations are independent between and within cohorts.
Sampling distribution of the sample mean is approximately normal by Central Limit Theorem (n=192).
